summary: Solid deliverable with strong PowerShell patterns: `Set-StrictMode -Version Latest`, proper error handling, cmdlet conventions, `-LiteralPath` for special chars. Workflow uses pinned action refs (v4, v7), explicit permissions, env vars. Minor issues: (1) github-script JSON parsing is fragile—should use env: instead of inline ${{ }} to avoid injection edge cases; (2) 4 `act push` runs exceeds stated 3-run limit; (3) glob regex lacks validation for malformed patterns; (4) test fixtures (labels.config.json, case*.json files) not shown, preventing correctness verification. Invoke-ActTests.ps1 well-structured with data-driven cases and proper cleanup, but output regex parsing depends on exact formatting fragility. Overall: clean, maintainable code lacking full verification due to missing config/fixtures.
